description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores for several language models across different evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis represents the categories: “EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”, listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “Probability”, ranges from 0 to 1 and is linearly scaled with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each category features a stacked bar composed of three segments, with the bottom segment representing “Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0”, the middle segment representing “SOLAR-10.7B-(base)”, and the top segment representing “KoBEST-10.8B-v1.0”. For “EVAL”, the “Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” segment has a value of approximately 0.42, the “SOLAR-10.7B-(base)” segment has a value of approximately 0.52, and the “KoBEST-10.8B-v1.0” segment has a value of approximately 0.46.  For “KoBEST-BQ”, the segments have values of approximately 0.49, 0.56, and 0.79 respectively.  For “KoBEST-CP”, the segments have values of approximately 0.58, 0.74, and 0.54 respectively. For “KoBEST-HS”, the segments have values of approximately 0.50, 0.69, and 0.54 respectively. For “KoBEST-SN”, the segments have values of approximately 0.59, 0.73, and 0.61 respectively. For “AVG”, the segments have values of approximately 0.55, 0.61, and 0.96 respectively.  The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
